ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (dark/black) to high-intensity (white/mottled/glare) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity base; high-intensity white/grey mottling concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe; light speckling on the distal tip of the left lobe; central region near the notch is predominantly low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 55-65 degree V-shaped depression; the lower vertex and base of the notch are obscured by water spray/turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; distinct deep notch on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 30% inward from the tip; sawtooth-like peaks visible along the continuous boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature following the trailing edge, tapering to acute, upward-turned points at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of orange-brown/white circular protrusions (barnacles) at both the extreme left and right lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and associated tissue scarring on the distal extremities of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-intensity specular reflection (glare) covering the central-distal portion of the right lobe, masking underlying pigmentation.
